name: playful-fashion-beauty-in-cart
image_purpose: UGC-style fashion and social campaign visual

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic playful fashion photo of an original approved adult woman seated safely inside a stationary shopping cart in a grocery produce aisle.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult blonde woman with a playful wink and relaxed confident expression sits safely in a stationary metal shopping cart. She wears a lime-green strapless crop top, high-waisted denim shorts, white socks, bright neon-green sneakers, and layered silver necklaces.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical full-body retail fashion framing, one leg bent and lifted toward the foreground, one hand near her face and the other near her necklace, colorful produce displays, cart basket, aisle signage, cool bright supermarket fixtures, and shallow background separation.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright indoor commercial grocery lighting, vibrant produce colors, crisp realistic shadows, playful bold fashion-editorial energy without a sexualized pose.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic smartphone or DSLR-style wide-angle photography, vertical 4:5, sharp subject, moderate depth of field, visible denim and produce texture, restrained saturation, no artificial HDR look.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic vertical 4:5 grocery-store fashion lifestyle photo of an original approved adult blonde woman with a playful wink and relaxed confident expression seated safely in a stationary metal shopping cart in a produce aisle. She wears a lime-green strapless crop top, high-waisted denim shorts, white socks, bright neon-green sneakers, and layered silver necklaces. One leg bends toward the foreground while her hands rest near her face and necklace. Colorful fruits and vegetables, aisle signage, bright commercial supermarket lighting, crisp natural detail, vibrant playful fashion-editorial mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, childlike features, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, unsafe cart movement, falling, traffic hazard, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, over-saturated, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, unreadable text

assets.name: grocery cart fashion reference
assets.usage: Match the original adult model, lime outfit, denim shorts, sneakers, cart pose, produce aisle, and commercial light.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve adult identity, outfit, pose, stationary-cart safety, grocery environment, and lighting. Store logos, signage, product packaging, typography, and jewelry branding are replaceable editable elements.
